acceptedAnswer.text: AKN Design Group brings over two decades of experience and a track record of more than 10,000 completed residential renovations, specializing in substantial, customized transformations. Our integrated design-build process means we manage the entire project from concept to completion, offering a single point of coordination for complex additions like multi-generational units. This comprehensive approach, combined with our commitment to honesty, reliability, and craftsmanship, ensures a seamless homeowner experience and a lasting impression for your Dallas–Fort Worth property.
acceptedAnswer.description: AKN Design Group's two decades of experience, 10,000+ completed projects, and integrated design-build process make us uniquely qualified to manage complex multi-generational unit additions in the DFW metroplex.
